1.consolidated_definition: Ayudar. Apoyar o patrocinar a una persona, obra o grupo. Frecuente. DRAE 2001 (esponsorizar). Porque ellos como que te auspician, te esponsorean. Y te dan ropa porque tú representas la tienda (Norma Culta joven, 15, 1995)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To assist or support a person, work, or group financially or otherwise. To frequently provide aid or patronage to someone or something. 

Note: The term "Norma Culta joven" refers to a cultural reference specific to Puerto Rico, but it is not translated as it is a proper noun and a cultural context that may be unfamiliar to non-Puerto Rican readers.

Also, the phrase "representas la tienda" can be translated to "serve as a representative of the store", preserving the original meaning.
